correctness.rationale: The infimal-convolution gauge, ordered-gap Jacobian, exact Dirichlet second moments, and symmetric covariance yield the closed formula. Differentiation and the strictly increasing quadratic q_{d,m} classify all possible local interior minima; negative one-sided jumps rule out integer minima. Endpoint signs and the two-index width prove complete fixed-d classification. Stirling and factorization of the one-parameter limiting derivative prove the optimal ratio and limiting value. The supplied checker separately verified symbolic identities, rational chamber formulas, and independently triangulated exact moments. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof of infinitely many dimensions.

value.rationale: This is the complete isotropic optimization of a natural continuum between cube and cross-polytope whose original paper provides only volume and facial geometry. The result gives explicit optimizers up to two algebraic candidates for every dimension, a universal limiting optimal fraction, and an exact limiting squared isotropic constant strictly smaller than both endpoints. These are meaningful geometric invariants and sharp optimization phenomena rather than a known volume-table recomputation.
